thread:
olivia: Hey design — need a compact creative bundle for next week's Performance launch + partner webinar. Scope: 1) benchmark one-pager (print + web) showing latency vs cost tradeoffs across Hosted / Dedicated / Private; 2) multi-state routing diagram (SVG + PNG) for the docs and signup flow; 3) webinar hero (1200x628), thumbnail (320x180); 4) three social creatives (square, X, LinkedIn); 5) editable slide deck template (title, data, diagram slides). Target first pass by Tue EOB.

tom: On it. A few clarifying q's: do you want absolute numbers on the chart or stylized distributions? And any strict brand color rules for the benchmark palette?

olivia: Prefer stylized distributions (show ranges) — legal wants hedged language. Use brand core palette but add 1 contrasting accent for cost callouts. Make sure colors meet AA contrast.

rachel: Brand note: use the new secondary palette (v2) for the dedicated/private fills. Also include the small Redwood medallion on the bottom-right of the one-pager. I'll do a quick pass once frames are up.

jared: For the SVG routing diagram — we need semantic IDs on groups so infra can hook events into the signup flow. Also export a dark-mode variant. Can you keep the icons as single-path outlines?

tom: Perfect — will produce an SVG with group IDs: hosted_node, dedicated_node, private_node, fallback_edge. Dark variant as inverted palette.

olivia: Copy notes from comms: use language like "typical observed latency" and footnote the model/instance used. Draft copy here: https://tiny.redwood/perf-copy-draft — please embed the footnote on the one-pager.

tom: Noted. For web export we should also include an optimized PNG at 2x for retina. Any motion required?

olivia: Motion optional for X — if you can do a subtle 8s loop that highlights the routing fallback, great. If not, static is fine.

rachel: Legal flagged that benchmark claims must include a testing date. Add "Tested: 2026-03-10" to the footnote.

jared: Also, growth needs the routing SVG uploaded to the CDN with a short JSON manifest for mapping IDs to analytics events. I'll take that after export.

tom: Plan: deliver Figma frames + exports (SVG, PNG, PDF one-pager, MP4 motion if any) by Tue 6pm PT. Will leave editable components for the slide deck and provide a Light + Dark master.

olivia: Can you include a tiny section on the one-pager: "How to get help" with links and hidden fields suggestion for the download form so leads are auto-tagged? Mapping below.

olivia: Lead mapping (please include as recommended hidden fields on assets/thank-you pages):
```
form_type: benchmark_download
utm_campaign: performance_launch
lead_priority: high
source: marketing_asset
```

tom: Added a small CTA area in the layout mock. Also added a placeholder for the HubSpot hidden fields.

olivia-bot: Creative brief created: CB-20260317-81. Deadline tag: fast-turn.

rachel: FYI, include export guidance for the content folks: editable slide deck in PPTX + Google Slides; one-pager in A4 PDF and optimized web PDF; SVG + 2x PNG for assets.

qa-bot: Accessibility check reminder: contrast, alt text for social images, and readable font sizes on the one-pager.

tom: Will run colors through contrast checker and add alt text drafts in the Figma file. Uploading initial frames: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/perf-kit (comment-only link).

olivia: This looks great. I'll sync growth and comms after first pass. Please ping here when frames uploaded. Thanks team :raised_hands:
